== Biography ==

The Caterpillar is a creature of Wonderland, possessed of a languid and drowsy manner. He is habitually occupied with smoking a hookah, which he must set aside to address anyone who crosses his path. When he speaks, his voice emerges slow and sleepy, as befits a creature of such deliberate temperament.

When Alice first encountered him, they regarded each other in silence for some time before the Caterpillar finally removed his hookah from his mouth and addressed her with a single, simple question: "Who are you?" On another occasion, Alice recited to him the poem "You are old, Father William," though the words came out in a form strangely different from their proper rendering. This curious fact greatly struck the attention of those who heard Alice relate it—the Mock Turtle in particular deemed it most curious indeed.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Alice]]''' — acquaintance. The Caterpillar encountered Alice and engaged her with the simple inquiry "Who are you?" It listened attentively to her recitation of "You are old, Father William," a poem she rendered in unexpected manner.
